senses.gloss:
सिद्ध p. p.
—1 Accomplished, effected, performed, achieved, completed.
—2 Gained, obtained, acquired.
—3 Succeeded, successful; one who has attained his object; यातावला
 व्रजं सिद्धा मयेमा रंस्यथ क्षपाः Bhāg. 10. 22. 27.
—4 Settled, established; नैसर्गिकी सुरभिणः कुसुमस्य सिद्धा मूर्ध्नि
 स्थितिर्न चरणैरवताडनानि U. 1. 14.
—5 Proved, demonstrated, substantiated; तस्मादिन्द्रियं प्रत्यक्षप्रमाणमिति
 सिद्धम् T. S.; साक्षिप्रत्ययसिद्धानि (कार्याणि) Ms. 8. 178.
—6 Valid, sound (as a rule).
—7 Admitted to be true.
—8 Decided, adjudicated (as a law-suit).
—9 Paid, discharged, liquidated (as debt).
—10 Cooked, dressed (as food);
[]
 अभ्रच्छाया खलप्रीतिः सिद्धमन्नं च योषितः । किंचित्कालोपभोग्यानि यौवनानि
 धनानि च ॥ Pt. 2. 117.
—11 Matured, ripened.
—12 Thoroughly prepared, compounded, cooked together (as drugs).
—13 Ready (as money).
—14 Subdued, won over, subjugated (as by magic).
—15 Brought under subjection, become propitious.
—16 Thoroughly conversant with or skilled in, proficient in; as in रससिद्ध q. v.
—17 Perfected, sanctified (as by penance); अप्रमत्तोऽखिलस्वार्थे यदि
 स्यात् सिद्ध आत्मनि Bhāg. 11. 23. 29.
—18 Emancipated.
—19 Endowed with supernatural powers or faculties.
—20 Pious, sacred, holy.
—21 Divine, immortal, eternal.
—22 Celebrated, well-known, illustrious; अथर्वशिरसि प्रोक्तैर्मन्त्रैः
 सिद्धां विधानतः Rām. 1. 15. 2; एवं तौ लोकसिद्धाभिः क्रीडाभिश्चेरतुर्वने Mb. 10. 18. 16.
—23 Shining, splendid.
—24 Hit (as a mark).
—25 Peculiar, singular.
—26 Invariable, unalterable. —27 Satisfied; Bhāg. 11. 23. 29.

सिद्ध + .{@-द्धः@}
—1 A semi-divine being supposed to be of great purity and holiness, and
 said to be particularly characterized by eight supernatural faculties
 called Siddhis q. v.; उद्वेजिता वृष्टिभिराश्रयन्ते शृङ्गाणि यस्यातपवन्ति
 सिद्धाः Ku. 1. 5.
—2 An inspired sage or seer (like Vyāsa).
—3 Any sage or seer, a prophet; सिद्धादेश Ratn. 1.
—4 One skilled in magical arts, a magician.
—5 A law-suit, judicial trial.
—6 A kind of hard sugar.
—7 The dark thorn-apple.
—8 One who has attained his object; सिद्धः कचो वत्स्यति मत्सकाशे Mb. 1. 76. 70.

सिद्ध + .{@-द्धम्@} Sea-salt.

सिद्ध + -अङ्गना, -योषित् a beatified woman, a female siddha.
सिद्ध + -अङ्गना, -योषित् a beatified woman, a female siddha.

सिद्ध + -अञ्जनम् magical ointment or collyrium; वसुपूर्णान् कलशान् सिद्धाञ्जनेन
 ज्ञात्वा Dk. 1. 4.

सिद्ध + -अन्तः
—1 the established end.
—2 the demonstrated conclusion of an argument, established view of any
 question, the true logical conclusion (following on the refutation of
 the Pūrvapakṣa).
—3 a proved fact, established truth, dogma, settled doctrine.
—4 any established text-book resting on conclusive evidence; मध्येसभं
 दैवविदः सर्वसिद्धान्तपारगाः Śiva B. 6. 80. ˚कोटिः f. the
 point in an argument which is regarded as a logical conclusion. ˚कौमुदी
 N. of a celebrated commentary on Pāṇiniʼs grammar by भट्टोजीदीक्षित.
 ˚पक्षः the logically correct side of an argument.
सिद्ध + -अन्नम् cooked food.
सिद्ध + -अर्थ a. one who has accomplished his desired object, successful.

सिद्ध + -अर्थ + .({@-र्थः@})
—1 white mustard; यन्त्रस्थसिद्धार्थपदाभिषेकं लब्ध्वाप्यसिद्धार्थममन्यत
 स्वम् N. 10. 6; अविरललग्नगौरसिद्धार्थकप्रकारतया काञ्चनरसखचितामिव
 मालाम् K. (Pūrvabhāga); Bhāg. 4. 9. 59.
—2 N. of Śiva.
—3 of the great Buddha.

सिद्ध + -आदेशः
—1 the prediction of a seer.
—2 a prophet, fortune-teller.
सिद्ध + -आपगा f. the river Gaṅgā.
सिद्ध + -आसनम् a particular posture in religious meditation.
सिद्ध + -औषधम् a specific panacea.
सिद्ध + -काम a. having the wishes fulfilled.
सिद्ध + -क्षेत्रम् the abode of sages or Siddhas.
सिद्ध + -गङ्गा, -नदी, -सिन्धुः the celestial Ganges.
सिद्ध + -गङ्गा, -नदी, -सिन्धुः the celestial Ganges.
सिद्ध + -गङ्गा, -नदी, -सिन्धुः the celestial Ganges.
सिद्ध + -ग्रहः N. of a particular kind of madness or dementia.
सिद्ध + -जलम्, -सलिलम् sour rice-gruel.
सिद्ध + -जलम्, -सलिलम् sour rice-gruel.
सिद्ध + -देवः N. of Śiva.

सिद्ध + -द्रव्यम्
[]
 any magical object.
सिद्ध + -धातुः quick-silver.
सिद्ध + -नरः sorcerer, fortune-teller.
सिद्ध + -पक्षः the established or logical side of an argument.

सिद्ध + -पथः the atmosphere; छिन्नाः सिद्धपथे देवैर्लघुहस्तैः सहस्रधा
 Bhāg. 6. 10. 25.
सिद्ध + -पुरुषः = सिद्धः (1, 3, 4) above.
सिद्ध + -पुष्पः the Karavīra plant.
सिद्ध + -प्रयोजनः white mustard.
सिद्ध + -मानस a. having a completely satisfied mind.
सिद्ध + -मोदकः sugar prepared from bamboo-manna.
सिद्ध + -यात्रिकः one wandering about for the acquisition of magical power; Pt. 5.
सिद्ध + -योगः magical agency.
सिद्ध + -योगिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
सिद्ध + -रस a. mineral, metallic.

सिद्ध + -रस + .({@-सः@})
—1 quick-silver; अयोविकारे स्वरितत्वमिष्यते कुतोऽयसां सिद्धरसस्पृशामपि N. 9. 42.
—2 an alchemist.
सिद्ध + -रूपम् the right or correct thing.
सिद्ध + -लक्ष a. one who has hit the mark.
सिद्ध + -लोकः the world of the Blest (सिद्ध).
सिद्ध + -वस्तिः a strong injection (of oil &c.); Suśr.
सिद्ध + -विद्या the doctrine relating to perfect beings.
सिद्ध + -वेदनः an elephant having perfect sensitivity; Mātaṅga L. 8. 25.
सिद्ध + -व्यञ्जनः an ascetic-spy; सिद्धव्यञ्जनैर्माणवप्रकाशनम् Kau. A. 4.
सिद्ध + -संकल्प a. one who has accomplished his desired object.
सिद्ध + -संबन्ध a. one whose kindred are well known.
सिद्ध + -साधकः N. of Śiva.
सिद्ध + -साधनः white mustard.

सिद्ध + -साधनः + .({@-नम्@})
—1 the performance of magical rites for the acquisition of supernatural powers &c.
—2 the materials employed in mystical or chemical processes.
सिद्ध + -साधित a. one who has learned by practice (not by study).
सिद्ध + -साध्य a. accomplished, proved.
सिद्ध + -साध्य + .({@-ध्यम्@}) a dogma, demonstrated conclusion.
सिद्ध + -सिद्ध a. thoroughly efficacious.
सिद्ध + -सेनः N. of Kārtikeya.

सिद्ध + -स्थाली the boiler or pot of a seer (it is supposed to be a vessel
 which is gifted with the property of overflowing with any kind of food
 at the desire of the possessor).
सिद्ध + -हेमन् purified gold.
सिद्धकः The Sāla tree.

सिद्धता, -त्वम्
—1 Accomplishment, fulfilment, perfection.
—2 Validity of a rule or doctrine.

सिद्धता, -त्वम्
—1 Accomplishment, fulfilment, perfection.
—2 Validity of a rule or doctrine.

सिद्धान्तिन् m.
—1 One who establishes a conclusion after noticing and answering objections
 (or पूर्वपक्ष).
—2 One learned in scientific text-books.
—3 A follower of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy.
सिद्धार्थकः White mustard; Dk. 2. 7.
सिद्धार्थकः + .{@-कम्@} A kind of ointment.

सिद्धिः f. [सिध्-क्तिन्]
—1 Accomplishment, fulfilment, completion, perfection, complete attainment
 (of an object); विरोधि सिद्धेरिति कर्तुमुद्यतः Ki. 14. 8; क्रियासिद्धिः
 सत्त्वे भवति महतां नोपकरणे Subhāṣ.
—2 Success, prosperity, welfare, well-being.
—3 Establishment, settlement.
—4 Substantiation, demonstration, proof, indisputable conclusion.
—5 Validity (of a rule, law &c.).
—6 Decision, adjudication, settlement (of a law-suit); कार्यकारणसिद्धौ
 च प्रसन्ना बुद्धिरव्यया Rām. 4. 18. 47;
 तस्मान्न लेखसामर्थ्यात् सिद्धिरैकान्तिकी मता Śukra. 4. 726.
—7 Certainty, truth, accuracy, correctness.
—8 Payment, liquidation (of a
[]
 debt); अधमर्णार्थसिद्धपर्थमुत्तमर्णेन चोदितः Ms. 8. 47.
—9 Preparing, cooking (as of drugs &c.).
—10 The solution of a problem.
—11 Readiness.
—12 Complete purity or sanctification.
—13 A superhuman power or faculty; (these faculties are eight:− अणिमा
 लघिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा । ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च तथा कामावसायिता ॥).
—14 The acquisition of supernatural powers by magical means.
—15 Marvellous skill or capability.
—16 Good effect or result.
—17 Final beatitude, final emancipation.
—18 Understanding, intellect.
—19 Concealment, vanishing, making oneself invisible.
—20 A magical shoe (supposed to convey the wearer wherever he likes).
—21 A kind of Yoga.
—22 N. of Durgā.
—23 Complete knowledge.
—24 Advantage, use, good effect.
—25 N. of Śiva (m. in this sense).
—26 Efficacy, efficiency.
—27 Becoming intelligible (as sounds or words).
—28 (In Rhet.) The pointing out in the same person of various good qualities.
.━{@Comp.@}: सिद्धिद, सिद्धिदात्री, सिद्धियोगः, सिद्धिविनायकः

सिद्धिः + -द a.
—1 granting success or supreme felicity.
—2 giving the eight superhuman faculties; हृदि विनिहितरूपः सिद्धिदस्तद्विदां
 यः Māl. 5. 1.
सिद्धिः + -द + .({@-दः@}) an epithet of Śiva.
सिद्धिः + -दात्री an epithet of Durgā.
सिद्धिः + -योगः a particular auspicious conjunction of planets.
सिद्धिः + -विनायकः a form of Gaṇeśa.
सीद्यम् Indolence, slothfulness, idleness.
